The euro has dropped to just above $1.1, the weakest since April 2025, as the dollar has rallied against other major currencies. posts.title: Draft deal calls for 'accelerated action to phase out fossil fuels'
posts.text: A draft “cover decision” has been issued to delegates, containing some of the most contentious resolutions under discussion at this Cop. The text is 18 pages long and contains 144 separate items, and many of them are unlikely to survive in their current form through future drafts. The items include a resolution that…

Chris Bowen, Australia’s climate minister and president of the negotiations, has opened a press conference by saying it “is a given” that parties will not agree on all elements of the draft. He added that the timing of this Cop – alongside the rise of AI, war and cost of living crises, among others – made it more…

A draft of the cover decision, the formal text tying together the summit’s outcomes, has just been released. Diplomats, journalists, activists and scientists are currently poring over it. We’ll provide expert analysis shortly.
